title: [Main] - Bug 657627: [Expense Agent] Expense User Card rejects manual approval setup with duplicate error
summary: The Expense User Card now reuses an existing unassigned approval setup instead of rejecting it with a duplicate error, and allows replacing an assigned approver after confirmation.
key_points: An unassigned existing setup is automatically assigned to the card owner
Replacing a different approver requires confirmation showing both approvers
Adding a user already assigned to the same approver preserves the original validation error
Noninteractive execution does not authorize approver replacement
Regression tests added for unassigned setup, confirmed replacement, and duplicate assignment scenarios
quote: Reuse an existing Expense Approval Setup when manually adding a user from the Expense User Card, rather than failing to insert a duplicate.
